Name: Ilucie's Emu (for 1.6)
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Adds fluffy Emus for your barn. Base is the vanilla Ostrich - I altered the sprites to change the curve of the neck and the colors.
After a few days they will lay emu eggs which can be incubated, sold or processed into mayonnaise.

The realistic Emu sprite is edited and recolored by the lovely [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CrimsonSolo/about-me]CrimsonSolo[/url] <3!

I hope you like them :D!

Downloads.Description:
fixed an error where regular mayo was produced instead of emu mayo
fixed not being able to ship emu mayo

emu eggs can now be incubated

added i18n support
